It includes sections for appetizers, entrees, and combination plates, with item names, descriptions, and prices listed. There are decorative red borders and some Chinese characters visible.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the menu text, particularly in item descriptions and some headings.
artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant portions of the text are illegible, consisting of malformed characters, pseudo-English, and nonsensical strings. This is a hallmark AI artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without generating valid language.

artifact_observations.location: Edges of the text characters and red border lines.
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight bleeding and softness in the edges of the printed text and lines, lacking the sharp crispness of real high-resolution print photography. Some characters appear to merge slightly into the background.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom right corner and overall grid alignment.
artifact_observations.reasoning: Minor inconsistencies in the alignment of columns and rows, suggesting a slight warping of the underlying grid structure, though not catastrophic.
